reasonUpgradeUnavailable: Prisma 7.9.1 is the current project version and resolves @prisma/config to deepmerge-ts 7.1.5. No compatible Prisma release using deepmerge-ts 8.0.0 or newer is currently available for this project to adopt.
exploitability: The vulnerable package is reached through Prisma configuration loading. This project uses a static prisma.config.ts and does not pass request data or other untrusted recursive/self-referential object graphs into that configuration path. Exploitation is therefore not known to be reachable in the deployed application, but the vulnerable transitive package remains installed.
compensatingControls: Keep prisma, @prisma/client, and @prisma/adapter-pg on the same reviewed release line.
Do not pass request-controlled or otherwise untrusted objects into Prisma configuration merging.
Run npm run audit:policy for every promotion and review any advisory range, severity, or dependency-path change.
Recheck Prisma releases for adoption of deepmerge-ts 8.0.0 or newer before this waiver expires.
revocationConditions: A compatible Prisma release resolves deepmerge-ts to version 8.0.0 or newer.
Untrusted or recursive object graphs become reachable by the Prisma configuration path.
The advisory severity, affected range, or installed dependency path changes.
New evidence invalidates the exploitability assessment or compensating controls.
